PostToolUse.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -q '\.cs$'; then dotnet format src/ErosTTS.Bot --include "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" --no-restore --verbosity quiet 2>/dev/null; dotnet format tests/ErosTTS.Bot.Tests --include "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" --no-restore --verbosity quiet 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
